title: 10 Actionable Hair Salon Marketing Ideas to Keep Your Chairs Full | BonusQR

facts.fact: The BonusQR article reports that local salons often see a 25-30% lift in bookings from targeted birthday and milestone promotions; this is the vendor's own unsourced claim.
facts.quote: local salons often report a 25-30% lift in bookings from these targeted promotions

facts.fact: BonusQR's article suggests a referral incentive of $20 off the next service for both the referring client and the new client.
facts.quote: For example, give both of them $20 off their next service.

facts.fact: BonusQR's article offers sample welcome copy for its QR loyalty program promising 10% off for scanning to join the VIP club.
facts.quote: Scan to Join Our VIP Club & Get 10% Off Today!

facts.fact: The BonusQR article was published on 26 February 2026.
BonusQR recommends setting a digital punch card reward at 6-8 punches, which it says feels attainable to clients while still encouraging commitment.
facts.quote: Aim for 6-8 "punches" to earn a reward. This feels attainable to clients while still encouraging commitment.

facts.fact: The BonusQR article states that salons often see booking spikes of 40-60% during well-executed flash sales. This is an unsourced vendor claim.
facts.quote: Salons often see booking spikes of 40-60% during well-executed flash sales.

facts.fact: The BonusQR article claims automated SMS appointment reminders can reduce costly no-shows by up to 40%. This is an unsourced vendor claim.
facts.quote: Automated SMS appointment reminders can reduce costly no-shows by up to 40%.

facts.fact: The BonusQR article claims post-visit thank-you emails with a booking link can increase rebooking rates by over 20%. This is an unsourced vendor claim.
facts.quote: Post-visit "thank you" emails with a booking link can increase rebooking rates by over 20%.

facts.fact: BonusQR suggests sending an automated "We miss you!" offer to clients who have not visited in 90 days to reactivate them.
facts.quote: An automated "We miss you!" offer sent to clients who haven't visited in 90 days can reactivate them.

facts.fact: BonusQR recommends giving top loyalty clients a 24-hour head start on any sale.
facts.quote: Reward your best clients with a 24-hour head start on any sale.

facts.fact: BonusQR recommends sending an SMS appointment reminder 24-48 hours before every appointment.
facts.quote: Send an SMS reminder 24-48 hours before every appointment to dramatically reduce no-shows.

facts.fact: BonusQR recommends sending an automated post-appointment follow-up email within 24 hours of a service.
facts.quote: Within 24 hours of a service, send an automated email asking for feedback and including a link to rebook.

facts.fact: BonusQR suggests running social media contests on a regular cadence, giving quarterly as an example.
facts.quote: Make contests a regular part of your marketing calendar (e.g., quarterly).

facts.fact: The BonusQR article states that featuring video testimonials on a salon's website and social media can increase conversion by over 80% compared to text-only reviews, without citing a source.
facts.quote: featuring video testimonials on your website and social media can increase conversion by over 80% compared to text-only reviews

facts.fact: The BonusQR article gives an example cross-promotion offer in which a partner boutique's customers receive 20% off their first service at the salon.
facts.quote: Show your receipt from [Partner Boutique] and get 20% off your first service with us.
